confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or price pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; July hotel and hostel rates vary widely by season, location and grade and are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer price relationship (about 1.8x and 1.35x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. EUR examples assume roughly 1.16 USD per EUR. FX: the 0.6955 figure for 2026-10-15 comes from search results describing the RBA Exchange Rates page, which I did not open. The same-day value may be provisional, so verify it against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Benchmarked loosely to general Nordic capital price levels (Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo), with Helsinki placed somewhat below the most expensive of these and well above Baltic capitals such as Tallinn and Riga.

anchor_basis.beer: 0.5 L domestic draft lager at a central restaurant, about 8.50 EUR
anchor_basis.coffee: regular cappuccino at a city-centre cafe, about 4.50 EUR
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: lunch special or kebab/pizza with soft drink at a local budget restaurant, about 15 EUR
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course mid-range dinner for two without drinks, about 110 EUR total
anchor_basis.cocktail: classic cocktail at a city-centre bar, about 15 EUR
anchor_basis.wine_glass: 150 ml house wine by the glass at a restaurant, about 11.50 EUR
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: bed in a 4-bed mixed dorm at a registered central hostel in July, about 45 EUR per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a registered hostel in July, about 115 EUR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: very basic registered guesthouse double room in July, about 125 EUR per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: registered three-star hotel double room in July, about 190 EUR per night
